ValidationRule.description: Opp can only have one Approved Estimate when Closed/Won.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: (ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Contract') || ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Approve') || ISPICKVAL( StageName , 'Closed')) && Number_of_Approves_Estimates__c != 1 && ISPICKVAL( Project_Type__c , 'Project') && CONTAINS( Service_Offering_Rollup__c , 'Salesforce') && NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) && NOT( $User.Id = '0053b00000CSZR6')
ValidationRule.errorMessage: There should be 1 and only 1 "Approved" Estimate related to this Opportunity. To move past the Propose Stage in this Opportunity, make sure only one Estimate is in the "Accepted" Stage.
